title: JANUS: Foreseeing Latent Risk for Long-Horizon Agent Safety
abstract: arXiv:2607.19913v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Agent safety is moving from content moderation toward preventing operational failures before tool-using agents act. We propose Janus, a foresight-oriented framework for long-horizon agent safety that trains guards to anticipate delayed risks from partial trajectories. Janus synthesizes diverse agent trajectories via multi-agent simulation and learns a shared policy with two coupled tasks: an anticipation task that forecasts safety-relevant futures and an adjudication task that decides safety from both the observed prefix and anticipated future. The two tasks are jointly optimized with CoAA-RL, which rewards forecasts by their utility for downstream safety judgment. The resulting guard model, Vanguard, blocks unsafe actions before execution. Across four agent-safety benchmarks, Vanguard improves average protection by 15.9 percentage points over baseline guards while increasing benign task completion by 5.1 percentage points.

translated_title: JANUS：面向长程智能体安全的潜在风险预见
translated_abstract: 智能体安全正从内容审核转向在工具使用智能体行动之前预防操作性失误。我们提出Janus，一个面向长程智能体安全的前瞻性框架，它训练守护模型从部分轨迹中预判延迟显现的风险。Janus通过多智能体模拟合成多样化的智能体轨迹，并以两个耦合任务学习一个共享策略：一个是预测与安全相关未来的预判任务，另一个是综合观察到的前缀与预判的未来来判定安全性的裁决任务。这两个任务通过CoAA-RL进行联合优化，该方法根据预测对下游安全判断的效用来给予奖励。由此得到的守护模型Vanguard能够在不安全操作执行之前将其拦截。在四个智能体安全基准测试中，Vanguard相比基线守护模型将平均防护能力提升了15.9个百分点，同时将良性任务完成率提升了5.1个百分点。
tldr: Janus提出前瞻式智能体安全框架，通过预判任务与裁决任务的联合强化学习训练出守护模型Vanguard，能够在不安全操作执行前预见延迟风险，使平均防护提升15.9个百分点、良性任务完成率提升5.1个百分点。
